The stale draft's first five statements (Func_02003bf0/Func_02003d44/Func_02003c20(0,0x20000,0x1999)/Func_02003c5a(0,0xe8,0xcc)) happen to be exactly this owner's five calls, byte-for-byte and argument-for-argument; everything the stale draft appended after that belongs to different, later instruction streams (likely subsequent owners sharing some of the same callees) and has been discarded here.

The task's hinted sibling family (resource_3aa:02001450 RunEventScript04, a four-channel-configure-plus-conditional-handoff shape, callees shifted by a uniform +0x44) does not structurally transfer to this owner: this owner has no loop, no conditional branch, no shared handoff callee, and its five callees (Func_02003bf0, Func_02003d44, Func_02003c20, Func_02003c5a, Func_02003c16) do not appear as a uniform-offset shift of RunEventScript04's callees or its resource_3aa:0200140c template. Two callees (Func_02003bf0, Func_02003d44, Func_02003c16) are called with no register setup and their results are never read afterward, so they are declared void(void); this is a reading aid, not a claim about their true signature -- the same addresses in other overlays host unrelated functions and were not consulted.
